title: Lifecore Biomedical to Participate at Upcoming Industry Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Lifecore Biomedical's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.lifecore.com/node/18826/pdf)


CHASKA, Minn., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. (NASDAQ:[LFCR](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=x-OKa34849XtSdXpBBGisYsSUzSVe2D0rYXnE-Jm8xYfUywspqQXMJrujokVTR8Dts7edtVNsyGg2fxghShPahhoXg-TuQEtl7ci9PTLIvM=) ) (“Lifecore”), a fully integrated injectables contract development and manufacturing organization (“CDMO”), today announced that the company will participate at three upcoming industry events.


At each conference, Lifecore leaders will host meetings with prospective customers to discuss process development and manufacturing services for injectable programs. Details regarding Lifecore’s participation are as follows:


- **CDMO Live Americas:**
Booth number: C19
Conference Dates: October 19-21, 2026
Location: Boston, MA


- **Partnership Opportunities in Drug Development (PODD)**
Booth number: 109
Conference Dates: October 29-30, 2026
Location: Boston, MA


Ryan Swanson, Ph.D., director of Lifecore’s Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T) group, will be a panel speaker at the following session:
*Designing Devices to Deliver High-Dose/High Viscosity Peptides & Biologics*
Fri, Oct 30 | 03:50 PM - 04:20 PM
Grand Ballroom


- **American Pharma Manufacturing & Outsourcing Summit**
Booth number: TBD
Conference Dates: November 20-23, 2026
Location: Boston, MA


If you are interested in meeting with Lifecore during this event, please reach out to us at:[cdmo@lifecore.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iOo2jePkL8NtrgO2yB3PwSM78HpczkVR677wTYz5Y3IbtWisIBx7a0E1SoYPwHftoSPrcypRHIzhxnSIMcovqEAXhqVv1yc4qutN909Qh8w=) .


**About Lifecore Biomedical**
Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. (Nasdaq: LFCR) is a fully integrated contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) that offers highly differentiated capabilities in the development, fill and finish of sterile injectable pharmaceutical products in syringes, vials, and cartridges, including complex formulations. As a leading manufacturer of premium, injectable-grade hyaluronic acid, Lifecore brings more than 40 years of expertise as a partner for global and emerging biopharmaceutical and biotechnology companies across multiple therapeutic categories to bring their innovations to market. For more information about the company, visit Lifecore’s website at[www.lifecore.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=QHmVrAJJFKl50boKruN8K2iWBh1dJ6T6zVa2-eMVWh7Ml9IX3mKEoprYmE6VQeyhxO5VOz5y-P2qNnGA4zr_NdDgTGvIQLaOxDvBNnKgwWk=) .
